Team — quick status update and a few technical questions I ran into while filling out metering_matrix.xlsx.

Summary so far:
- Redwood tokenized runtime emits billing counters that map to: input_tokens, output_tokens, embeddings_units, and inference_hours (for long-running pipelines).
- Suggested CloudPeak mapping: input/output tokens -> "Text Units" SKU; embeddings_units -> "Vector Indexing" SKU; inference_hours -> "Dedicated Compute" SKU. See attached sheet for column mapping.

Questions for @Olga: for SOC2 we should provide an official pointer to the audit report hosted in our secure drive. Do we want to surface a redacted snapshot in the binder or just link to the report and include contact for auditor verification?

Pricing parity language: draft below — please refine.
"Redwood Inference confirms that pricing offered via CloudPeak marketplace will not exceed our standard list pricing for functionally-equivalent consumption tiers and entitlements, and we will notify CloudPeak in advance of any pricing changes that would affect customers procured via the marketplace."

I pulled together an initial metering_matrix.xlsx. Attaching.

Vivek
